findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: otto_equity_intel, otto_equity_news, otto_earnings_calendar, otto_native_yield_userop, otto_delegation_cap · Private data: otto_tokenized_equities, otto_rh_season, otto_base_season, otto_stock_pools, otto_tokenized_stock_movers, otto_pools_search, otto_token_security, otto_stock_token_quote, otto_prepare_bridge, otto_prepare_polymarket_order, otto_prepare_yield_deposit, otto_prepare_yield_withdraw, otto_prepare_stock_buy, otto_sponsored_account, otto_submit_under_delegation, otto_delegation_fence, otto_delegation_status, otto_delegation_revoke, otto_delegation_cap, otto_delegation_operations, otto_delegation_reconcile, otto_delegation_exit, otto_muse_autopay_availability, otto_muse_autopay_prepare, otto_muse_autopay_enroll, otto_muse_autopay_status, otto_muse_autopay_revoke, otto_x_recipes · Public sink: otto_tokenized_stock_movers, otto_financial_statements, otto_prepare_yield_deposit, otto_prepare_yield_withdraw, otto_sponsored_account, otto_submit_under_delegation, otto_delegation_fence, otto_delegation_status, otto_delegation_exit · Destructive: otto_prepare_swap, otto_prepare_bridge, otto_submit_under_delegation.
